topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for Event streams, Trigger definitions/matches, causal graph edges, runner handoff, loop bounds and provenance traces.

semantics.identity_rule: Event, Trigger, runner, operation and resulting Event identities remain distinct.
semantics.graph_rule: Visual graph edges correspond only to explicit causality edges.
semantics.action_rule: Enable/disable/edit/fire-test actions invoke separate authorized canonical operations.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing Events/Triggers grants no execution authority.
semantics.payload_rule: Sensitive Event payload fields are redacted according to policy.
semantics.trace_rule: Displayed causality retains exact source/target/rule refs.

invariants.rule: Event, Trigger, Runner and resulting Event are separate explicit identities connected only by declared causality edges; matching or adjacency never implies execution.
